{"sample_id":"arvo_14455",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1159,"var":"buffer","code":"return parse_proxy_protocol_v2(request, buffer);","role":"source","note":"Input buffer is dispatched to proxy v2 parser based on first 4 bytes matching \\x0D\\x0A\\x0D\\x0A"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":229,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","role":"intermediate","note":"size is computed from attacker-controlled hdr->len field; size = 16 + ntohs(hdr->len)"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":230,"var":"size","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","role":"root_cause","note":"Check only validates size <= sizeof(proxy_header_v2) but does not validate size <= actual input length (helper->buffer->len), allowing buffer advancement past received data"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":271,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer += size;","role":"intermediate","note":"buffer pointer advanced by size (52) which exceeds actual input length (16), moving pointer past valid data"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":275,"var":"adjusted_size","code":"const size_t adjusted_size = (size_t)(helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len - buffer);","role":"intermediate","note":"adjusted_size underflows: (base + 16) - (base + 52) = -36 wraps to huge size_t value"},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":276,"var":"adjusted_size","code":"helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","role":"sink","note":"memmem called with underflowed size reads far past the end of the buffer, causing heap/global buffer overflow"}
 ],

   "sink":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":276,"operands":["buffer","adjusted_size"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"adjusted_size","right":"helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len - buffer"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1159,"operands":["buffer"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":229,"operands":["hdr->len"]},
      "type":"data","via":["buffer","hdr->len"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":229,"operands":["size"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":271,"operands":["buffer"]},
      "type":"data","via":["size"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":271,"operands":["buffer"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":276,"operands":["adjusted_size"]},

 }}
